any.title: Any
any.body: You may choose any Monster on the wheel, not only the one you are facing.

eject.title: Eject
eject.body: remove them from the dungeon immediately, placing them on the bottom of the Dungeon Deck

across.title: Across
across.body: across on the opposite side of the wheel.

bear_trap.title: Bear Trap
bear_trap.body: a 2 HP 3 ATK monster that Attacks you when you Move or Spin onto it

move.title: Move
move.body: shift to a Neighbor without Spinning

flee.title: Flee
flee.body: If you are facing them, Spin the wheel at random. They are not removed.

defeated.title: Defeated
defeated.body: They leave the wheel. Flee is different — they stay. Escaped means you took the hit and lived.

marked.title: Marked
marked.body: upon Defeat, Trapper gains +2 HP and ATK

poison.title: Poison
poison.body: When you Spin that monster, they lose that much HP immediately, then the mark clears. Other marked monsters keep theirs. Your Poison pays first on a Spin. Not Attack.

spin.title: Spin
spin.body: The wheel lands on a random living monster.

always.title: Always
always.body: Always: cannot be changed in any other way

swap.title: Swap
swap.body: Swap: trade it for a random item of the same rank (Weak, Tough or Deadly).

loaded.title: Loaded
loaded.body: Loaded: your next Attack can hit any monster.

rust.title: Rust
rust.body: Gain 2 Block, Lose 1 HP. Whenever you Gain Block, Gain 1 Rust.

decay.title: Decay
decay.body: If you Use this, Keep it and Discard all other Items with Decay.

gaze.title: Gaze
gaze.body: Marks up to three Items. Using one Petrifies the others while the Basilisk remains.

petrify.title: Petrify
petrify.body: Makes an Item Unplayable until its source ends.

curse.title: Curse
curse.body: A harmful Item forced into your hand.

shroud.title: Shroud
shroud.body: Hidden until Defeated, or until you resolve combat while facing them

toll.title: Toll
toll.body: Unplayable. −1 on each Item Use. At 0, you Die.

hex.title: Hex
hex.body: Unplayable. −1 each Spin. At 0, Defeat the landed enemy.

beggar.title: Beggar
beggar.body: Marks a random Item. Spinning this Beggar discards it.

neighbor.title: Neighbor
neighbor.body: The spaces right beside another on the wheel: one to its left, one to its right.

keep.title: Keep
keep.body: This item stays in your hand after you use it.

attack.title: Attack
attack.body: Damage from a strike. HP lost any other way doesn't count as Attack.
